sub_agent_reviews.summary: Single merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety. BPO, GFlowRL, and MemPoison were found already published, then Answer Leakage was selected from the same table.
Read arXiv metadata, HTML, PDF text, official GitHub README, repository file layout, and recent release commits.
Article reconstructs one-bit intervention, AFR/dAFR definitions, main benchmark tables, carrier split, cross-model prediction, and reproducibility constraints.
Review emphasizes matched-set size, eight-model fit limits, task-boundary failures on multiple-choice benchmarks, verifier-version sensitivity, and GPU/gated-model reproducibility costs.
Markdown uses self-contained TL;DR, h3 sections, tables, formulas, pseudocode, Mermaid, and only localized image references.
